license.note: openflights.org is not reachable from the build environment (proxy refusal); the licence was read from the site's own source in its repository.

method: Routes folded into undirected airport pairs; a pair's weight is the number of airlines flying it. Airports from airports.dat.
caveats: A historic snapshot: OpenFlights' route file is no longer maintained (roughly 2014); routes since opened or closed are not reflected.
Airline count is not passenger volume.
